statements: The Directory shows a list of suggested DReps, a search by DRep ID or name, and a control that shows all DReps.
A search by ID starts at 8 characters after the drep prefix. A complete ID that fails validation is reported as invalid, and a complete valid ID that matches a DRep opens that DRep's details.

Each DRep has View details and, unless the selected wallet already delegates to it, Delegate. Below the list, under the predefined options heading, Abstain and No Confidence each have a Select button. Selecting a DRep or an option passes it on for delegation.
